commits.message:
fix: check every message type and make the tests prove what they claim

Fixes Qodo's 6 findings on #10. Every message another device can send now has a check in check.js (want, have, dropcheck, need, presence, clock, join results and connection setup); anything without one is dropped. Rule 1 now says exactly that and Rule 3 explains the one shared relay queue. The two-browser test drags with the mouse, aims malformed pieces at a real transfer and has the late guest download and verify a file. npm run serve works on Windows.

fix: prune stale joins, hold relay frames for slow keys, verify file fingerprints

Fixes the 3 findings from Qodo's re-review of #8: forget joins to devices that left so guests keep accepting layouts; hold a peer's relay frames until its key arrives instead of dropping them after a timeout; require exact piece lengths and check each received file against the SHA-256 announced with its print, retrying from another holder if it doesn't match.

fix: check everything received from other devices

Fixes Qodo findings 1, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 on #8: validate prints, moves, pieces and pushes (web/check.js); only accept pieces for requested transfers, with size caps and retries; strict room codes; keep prints when their screen leaves; re-announce held prints; queue early ICE candidates; skip undecodable images. Also answers first-time keys so a just-joined device can't miss one.

fix: define KEY_TIMEOUT and send the layout sender

Qodo's fix PR #9 used KEY_TIMEOUT without defining it (ReferenceError on connect) and required payload.from on layouts that sendLayout() never sent. Values as Qodo suggested on #9.
fix: Validate layout broadcasts from the current leader

feat: start the photo table, replacing Polywogs

I changed my mind about the project. Removes the Polywogs code and adds the working photo-table spike: devices join screens into one table, share photos as prints, and take the ones they want, directly over WebRTC or through an end-to-end encrypted relay. Pages now publishes web/ as a static site.
